ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and follow the money to determine who is behind the scheme
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. I will be using data analysis and public records to follow the money and track down the perpetrators
